description: This header file declares functions related to JSON Web Encryption (JWE) using various cryptographic methods, including RSA, AES, and GCM modes, within the libwebsockets project.

methods.name: lws_jwe_auth_and_decrypt_rsa_aes_cbc_hs
methods.description: Authenticates and decrypts JWE using RSA and AES-CBC-HMAC-SHA.

methods.name: lws_jwe_encrypt_rsa_aes_cbc_hs
methods.description: Encrypts JWE using RSA and AES-CBC-HMAC.

methods.name: lws_jwe_auth_and_decrypt_cbc_hs
methods.description: Performs authentication and decryption for CBC-HS encrypted JWEs.

methods.name: lws_jwe_auth_and_decrypt_gcm
methods.description: Authenticates and decrypts JWE using GCM mode.

methods.name: lws_jwe_auth_and_decrypt_rsa_aes_gcm
methods.description: Authenticates and decrypts JWE using RSA and AES-GCM.

methods.name: lws_jwe_encrypt_rsa_aes_gcm
methods.description: Encrypts JWE using RSA and AES-GCM.

methods.name: lws_jwe_encrypt_aeskw_cbc_hs
methods.description: Encrypts JWE using AES key wrap and CBC-HMAC.

methods.name: lws_jwe_auth_and_decrypt_aeskw_cbc_hs
methods.description: Authenticates and decrypts JWE using AES key wrap and CBC-HMAC.

methods.name: lws_jwe_auth_and_decrypt_ecdh_cbc_hs
methods.description: Authenticates and decrypts ECDH-derived CBC-HMAC encrypted JWE.

methods.name: lws_jwe_encrypt_ecdh_cbc_hs
methods.description: Encrypts JWE using ECDH and CBC-HMAC.
